Take the hashtag #xoxoFest. Share Graphics about CON, Anita, Fish and Rami

** HIGHLIGHTS FROM XOXO FEST 2015**

Music

Friday, 6 PM, Phil Fish

Polytron founder and Fez designer Phil Fish opens XOXO Music with a rare DJ set of electronic and dance music.

http://2015.xoxofest.com/music

Conference

Saturday, 4:15 PM, Zoe Quinn, Crash Override

Zoe Quinn is a Harley-riding cyborg badass. Undeterred by a year of vicious harassment, she continued to spread the gospel of indie games with learning resources like Sorting Hat and Games Are For Everyone, and launched Crash Override, a volunteer-run task force for victims and targets of online mob hatred.

Sunday, 2:40 PM, Rami Ismail. Vlambeer

Rami Ismail is the developer and “business guy” at Vlambeer, the Dutch indie game studio responsible for games like Super Crate Box, Nuclear Throne, and Ridiculous Fishing. On the side, he builds tools like presskit and distribute to help indies do what they’re often worst at: explain what they do and promote their work.

http://2015.xoxofest.com/conference

Saturday, Sep 12

Tabletop

Gather with fellow attendees to play some of the best of the indie card, board and RPG scene with the designers who created them

http://2015.xoxofest.com/

Film & Animation

Saturyday, 9:30 PM, Feminist Frequency

Most coverage of Anita Sarkeesian’s pioneering video series about the representation of women in videogames focused on the backlash spawned from her blockbuster Kickstarter campaign. She’s released nearly three solid hours of intensely-researched video essays since—they catalogued 548 examples of the Damsels in Distress trope alone while researching the videos. It’s having an impact, with more games including playable female characters, but there’s a long way to go. We’re thrilled to have Anita back at XOXO for a chat about her work, process, and where it’s headed.

In short:

Friday 11 September, (6 PM) - Phil Fish Saturday 12, (7 PM - 1 AM) - Tabletop Saturday 12 September, (4:15 PM) - Zoe Quinn Saturday 12 September, (9:30 PM) - Feminist Frequency Sunday 13 September, (2:40 PM) - Rami Ismail
